attchmntText: Roto Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Roto Pumps Limited approved standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit after tax of 1,475.18 Lakhs for the quarter and 2,266.09 Lakhs for the half-year. Earnings per share were 0.78 for the quarter and 1.20 for the half-year. The board also approved a loan of up to Rs. 10 crores to wholly owned subsidiary Roto Energy Systems Limited. This loan aims to facilitate repayment of higher-cost borrowing and meet operational expenditure requirements. The financial results have been reviewed by statutory auditors R.N. Marwah & Co. LLP. The board meeting was held on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Roto Pumps Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Roto Pumps Limited submitted its reviewed standalone and consolidated Ind-AS compliant financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on November 11, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 7,585.58 Lakhs, with a net profit after tax of Rs. 1,475.18 Lakhs. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 13,330.75 Lakhs, and net profit after tax was Rs. 2,266.09 Lakhs. The statutory auditors, R.N. Marwah & Co. LLP, issued a review report stating that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The results are available on the company website and will be published in newspapers.
